cases.question: For each claim, what share of its total recorded amount is reserved expense?

cases.question: For each claim, what is its paid-loss-to-reserved-loss ratio?

cases.question: What is the average annual premium entry for each policy?
cases.goldSql: SELECT p.Policy_Number AS policy_number, AVG(pa.Policy_Amount) AS average_annual_premium FROM main.policy p JOIN main.policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier=p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier=pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Which policy has the higher annual premium effective in 2019, and what is that premium?
cases.goldSql: SELECT p.Policy_Number AS policy_number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium_2019 FROM main.policy p JOIN main.policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier=p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier=pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier WHERE pa.Effective_Date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND pa.Effective_Date<DATE '2020-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY annual_premium_2019 DESC,policy_number LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was the 2019 paid-loss ratio for each policy with a covered claim opened in 2019?
cases.goldSql: WITH prem AS (SELECT p.Policy_Number AS policy_number, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium FROM main.policy p JOIN main.policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier=p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier=pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier WHERE pa.Effective_Date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND pa.Effective_Date<DATE '2020-01-01' GROUP BY 1), losses AS (SELECT p.Policy_Number AS policy_number, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS paid_loss FROM main.policy p JOIN main.policy_coverage_detail cd ON cd.Policy_Identifier=p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.claim_coverage cc ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier=cd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier JOIN main.claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier=cc.Claim_Identifier JOIN main.claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier=c.Claim_Identifier JOIN main.loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier=ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND c.Claim_Open_Date<DATE '2020-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT prem.policy_number, losses.paid_loss*1.0/prem.annual_premium AS paid_loss_ratio FROM prem JOIN losses USING (policy_number) ORDER BY 1

cases.question: For each policy, how many covered insured objects have an annual premium entry?
cases.goldSql: SELECT p.Policy_Number AS policy_number, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.Insurable_Object_Identifier) AS insured_object_count FROM main.policy p JOIN main.policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier=p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier=pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier JOIN main.policy_coverage_detail cd ON cd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier=pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: How much annual premium effective in 2019 is tied to each insured property postal code?
cases.goldSql: SELECT a.Postal_Code AS postal_code, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium_2019 FROM main.policy p JOIN main.policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Identifier=p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier=pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier JOIN main.policy_coverage_detail cd ON cd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier=pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier JOIN main.insurable_object io ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier=cd.Insurable_Object_Identifier JOIN main.geographic_location g ON g.Geographic_Location_Identifier=io.Geographic_Location_Identifier JOIN main.location_address a ON a.Location_Address_Identifier=g.Location_Address_Identifier WHERE pa.Effective_Date>=DATE '2019-01-01' AND pa.Effective_Date<DATE '2020-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Which property postal code has the most covered claims, and how many claims are there?
cases.goldSql: SELECT a.Postal_Code AS postal_code, COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS claim_count FROM main.claim c JOIN main.insurable_object io ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier=c.Insurable_Object_Identifier JOIN main.geographic_location g ON g.Geographic_Location_Identifier=io.Geographic_Location_Identifier JOIN main.location_address a ON a.Location_Address_Identifier=g.Location_Address_Identifier GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY claim_count DESC,postal_code LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average claim closing time in days by claimed property postal code?
cases.goldSql: SELECT a.Postal_Code AS postal_code, AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',c.Claim_Open_Date,c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS average_days_to_close FROM main.claim c JOIN main.insurable_object io ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier=c.Insurable_Object_Identifier JOIN main.geographic_location g ON g.Geographic_Location_Identifier=io.Geographic_Location_Identifier JOIN main.location_address a ON a.Location_Address_Identifier=g.Location_Address_Identifier GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
